approval.decision: Publish the synchronized Swift icon catalog as Lumen 3 instead of misclassifying exhaustive-enum source changes as a minor release.

policy.compatibility: Every Swift API digester diagnostic relative to Lumen 2.1.0 must be explicitly listed. Toolchain-specific duplicate diagnostic markers are normalized without suppressing distinct API changes.
policy.versioning: Adding cases to a public Swift enum can invalidate exhaustive consumer switches, so the synchronized catalog ships as a coordinated major release.

changes.currentContract: Lumen 2.1.0 exposes the prior synchronized LumenIconName catalog.
changes.replacement: Lumen 3 exposes the updated synchronized LumenIconName catalog while preserving every existing case and component signature.
changes.migration: Exhaustive switches over LumenIconName must handle the new cases or include an @unknown default branch. Ordinary icon and component calls require no migration.
